paragraphs: Menachem bar Mevasima, brother of R' Yonatan Kippa.
Mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot, reporting in the name of R' Imi.[^1]

notes.text: Mevasima follows מבסימא, not unsupported Mevasya. Companion notice 34 has מכסימא/Maksima, and קיפא versus this קיפה; these separate supplied spellings remain distinct without identity/source harmonization. Older machine מבמסימא/סיפה differs from supplied forms. Kippa belongs to Yonatan in the connected brother phrase. End-of-Maaserot has no invented chapter/halakhah or named verification; Menachem is the understood reporter. He has no title; Yonatan and Imi remain R'.
